mentions.description: Mojave Paint is a commercial Mac app image editor positioned as a competitor to Photoshop and Affinity Photo, built by a small indie shop.

mentions.name: Mojave Paint
mentions.description: Mac app image editor with a Photoshop-like feature set, including layers and blend modes, styled with a retro look and feel. It supports in-app purchases.
mentions.source_excerpt: Got my first in app purchase for my first Mac app, a photoshop like image editor with layers and blend modes and a pretty retro look and feel. $8 in revenue so far! https://mojavepaint.app
